contract.request: 把全部目标箱放入统一目标区并由固定平台完整支撑。只允许修改XYZ，不允许改yaw。按完整包围盒验收，底面须贴合平台顶面，无浮空、穿透、箱间重叠，XZ中心间距至少0.9米，并避开保留通道。其余对象及字段不变。

definitions.inventory: All initial IDs and counts unchanged; no create/delete/scale/reparent
definitions.collision_pairs: all target-target and target-fixed entities except Floor
definitions.regions: full current world AABB containment, closed endpoints
definitions.facing_reference: CURRENT object center or fixed public marker; never initial table center
definitions.native_inventory: All initial task entities and every initial scene GameObject and component remain; no create/delete/reparent/enable changes.
definitions.native_protected_fields: Only allowed root world position/yaw fields may change. Other scene hierarchy, serialized component fields, mesh geometry, materials, and project assets/settings/scripts remain unchanged. Original pose/scale tolerances still apply.
